create_instances_object: create an Instances object with image size and initial fields like boxes, masks, and labels
set_instances_field: set a field on an Instances object such as gt_boxes or pred_classes with a tensor value
get_instances_field: get a field from an Instances object by name, returning the stored tensor or value
filter_instances_by_index: filter an Instances object using integer indices, slices, or boolean masks to select subsets
concatenate_instances_lists: concatenate multiple Instances objects into a single Instances by stacking all fields along dimension 0
move_instances_to_device: move all tensor fields in an Instances object to a specified device like cuda or cpu
check_instances_field_exists: check whether a named field exists in an Instances object using the has method
remove_instances_field: remove a named field from an Instances object to clean up unused data
get_all_instances_fields: retrieve all fields from an Instances object as a dictionary mapping field names to values
